title: Context Pooling
content:
Memory management is critical for high-concurrency systems. Photon implements an advanced Object Pooling mechanism for its context instances.

GC Elimination

Each HTTP request typically allocates a context object that must be garbage collected. Under high load, this causes GC spikes. Photon maintains a pre-allocated pool of contexts that are recycled immediately after a response is sent.

  • Pooled Instances: 256 (Default)
  • Overflow Strategy: On-demand creation with cleanup
  • Lifecycle: acquire -> dispatch -> reset -> release
